purpose: Paraphrase coverage across every active USER_EXPLICIT behavior rule. holdout-* queries were written before their first retrieval result was observed and were not used to tune the retriever.

cases.query: keep reports concise without doing less work
a correction should not make you abandon the task you were already doing
new user messages should interrupt ongoing work immediately
do not accept my causal theory just because I suggested it
if a tool path breaks, continue through another usable route rather than declaring the task dead
verify live state before making claims about what is currently true
if an emergency memory save happens before telling me, it still has to be disclosed immediately afterward
don't call a tool unavailable until you have actually tried to use that route
handle the technical coordination yourself instead of making me babysit it
when a repair doesn't work, inspect the exact failing path instead of trying random changes
do the actual work before giving me progress updates and finish the bounded job
check that the validator exercised the real production path, not merely that output looks right
a short prompt can still require deep analysis if the task is difficult
do not disable scheduled workers merely because one run is blocked
use the tool call that can settle the question rather than lots of low-value probes
my instruction governs your behavior even if its factual claim has not been proven
when I call out a slopwall, write a fresh incident report for that occurrence and then resume the original task
for a small status or yes-no answer, lead with the answer and keep it to one short paragraph without bullets or arrows
I choose the direction and judge the result; you handle planning execution verification and coordination
arm all five fresh workers, launch worker one immediately, report the arm, work on repos instead of waiting, then verify and repair until worker one is healthy
in normal chat avoid bullet lists and arrow-heavy formatting; write compact cohesive prose unless I ask for a list
before you answer me in a new chat, first check the live status even if I only said hi
if the current worker fleet is bugged, replace it with five fresh workers in one setup pass and use worker one execution as the acceptance gate
